set.body:
Scope
Run the frozen GazeWeave contract on the external Wang et al. paired encoding and 5-second blank-screen imagery dataset (28 participants, 100 images).

Acceptance criteria
- Obtain the authors original event data from a verifiable mirror or user-provided archive; record checksum, provenance, license, and acquisition date.
- Freeze import, exclusions, participant/item folds, candidate pools, units, algorithms, baselines, gates, and thresholds before outcome scoring.
- Validate the documented 1920 x 1200 coordinates, fixation columns, image markers, 28 participants, 100 images, and paired encoding/recall trials.
- Run Replay, Transport v2, registered density, nested MultiMatch, and elastic baselines under identical folds with negative/order controls.
- Persist manifests, fold receipts, uncertainty, runtime, and a bounded verdict with no post-result tuning.

Current blocker
The author project page and GitHub repositories document eye_movement_events.zip, imgData.zip, and raw_samples.zip, but the legacy cybertron.cg.tu-berlin.de URLs return HTTP 404 as of 2026-08-16. The repositories contain code and placeholder README files, not the event data; the Internet Archive has no captured event ZIP. Completion requires an author mirror or a user-provided copy.
set.title: GW-10 Run the external Wang mental-imagery court
